subject: Zoning Ordinance Cleanup
overview: The Community Development Board approved a modification to the site plan for 161 Mystic Avenue. The board also reviewed draft proposals for upcoming citywide zoning cleanup amendments, which cover formatting, height definitions, and development incentives.

items.title: 161 Mystic Avenue Site Plan Modification
items.summary: Approved a modification to the previously approved site plan to add a second story, with a condition maintaining the proposed parking layout.

items.title: Zoning Cleanup Draft Amendments
items.summary: The board discussed several draft amendments to standardize formatting, update height definitions citywide, and consolidate development incentives.

items.title: General Zoning and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff provided updates on the procurement of zoning and communications consultants.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting.
